main.description: Report each question's precision and recall at a threshold for one evaluation (model and policy version), over the results administrators verdicted while their scored content is still current, using each result's most recent verdict. Threshold, precision and recall are integer parts per million. Admin identity comes from the authenticated service context, never request fields.

threshold.description: Probability in parts per million at or above which a result counts as flagged

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: Authentication is required; authenticate with an instance administrator's service account before retrying.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The authenticated actor is not an instance administrator; do not retry.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: modelId, policyVersion or threshold is missing or invalid; correct the request before retrying.

output.description: Precision report for one evaluation at one threshold

verdictedCount.description: Number of verdicted results whose scored content is still current

unreviewableCount.description: Number of the evaluation's results whose subject was edited or deleted after scoring, verdicted or not

questions.description: Per-question counts and ratios, sorted by question

atOrAbove.description: Verdicted results scored at or above the threshold

present.description: Verdicted results whose verdict says the content is present

truePositive.description: Results both at or above the threshold and verdicted present

precision.description: truePositive / atOrAbove in parts per million; absent when atOrAbove is 0

recall.description: truePositive / present in parts per million; absent when present is 0
